root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify the cilium-side wrapper (pkg/bpf/collection.go::LoadCollectionSpec) that hands a shared reader/MapSpec to cilium/ebpf, AND the cilium/ebpf side (map.go::createMap or collection.go that consumes it). The report must name both files and explain that mutation of shared state across goroutines is the source of corruption.
evaluation_criteria: Names pkg/bpf/collection.go (or equivalent) on the Cilium side
Names cilium/ebpf map.go and/or collection.go as the consumer
States that shared mutable state (reader cursor or MapSpec field) causes the corruption

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: regenerateBPF (or equivalent endpoint regen entry) -> datapath loadDatapath -> LoadCollectionSpec -> cilium/ebpf MapSpec consumption -> bpf() syscall returns error. The report must show that two concurrent pod starts share state at the cilium/ebpf seam.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions endpoint regeneration as the trigger
Mentions the datapath loader (loadDatapath or netlink.go)
Mentions the cilium/ebpf library as the consumer of shared state

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the Cilium endpoint manager, the datapath loader, and the cilium/ebpf library as the affected components.
evaluation_criteria: Names Cilium endpoint manager (pkg/endpoint or equivalent)

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) serialize regenerations with a mutex, (b) deep-copy the MapSpec or reader per call, OR (c) upstream fix in cilium/ebpf to enforce caller-private readers.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes one of: serialization/mutex, deep-copy/clone, or upstream library fix
Identifies where the fix would live (Cilium loader, Cilium pkg/bpf wrapper, or cilium/ebpf)
